assign.outcome:
**The convergence round landed — the program now reads as one work.** [theories/synthesis/](/imagine/research/theories/synthesis/) is rewritten as the capstone across all four topics and 320 entries, and the [program front](/imagine/research/) surfaces it above the legend.

![](shot.png)

**The thesis, in two lines.** In every one of these disputes the decisive test is cheap, permitted and unperformed - each argument rests on a single measurement nobody has repeated, which is exactly why none of them ends. And the fight over that gap is not science against its critics: it is science visibly correcting itself, five times in eighteen months, while the claims that need the gap keep it open.

**Five sections, each cross-topic:** invented traditions have a signature and a name (4 cases + Hobsbawm & Ranger 1983); every dispute rests on one unreplicated measurement (Dunn, the vases, the Nimitz radar, the YD markers - and metrology already has the answer, the interlaboratory comparison); resolved is a range and only AARO admits it (ICD 203); five retractions and reversals all pointing the same way; agency displacement, rediscovery downstairs and untested above. Plus the thread nobody asked for - AI citogenesis caught twice, a prophecy dated to 1958/1959/1963/1980, a citation with no source, and a government that manufactured evidence on purpose - so the programs own method (fetch the page and read it) is itself a result. And a short section on what the program did NOT find, where the mainstream is genuinely thin.

**Five questions for round 4**, one logged `question` entry each in theories/log.jsonl:
1. Why has nobody pointed an instrument at the object? (Nosek: replication funding is near zero)
2. Does agency displacement survive a pre-registered test, now that there are six instances?
3. Is the recency signature a signature, or is it what every tradition looks like?
4. How much of what this program read was machine-invented? (the program can audit itself)
5. Does resolved mean the same thing in any two of these four topics?

**16 new validated entries, 304 -> 320**, all four logs `--check` clean: stone 107, depictions 73, disclosure 74, theories 66.

**The front tweak** (smallest change, in Program.js): `found()` now also detects a `<topic>/synthesis/page.js` by convention, and a new `capstone_card()` renders one link card between the head and the legend, reusing `.research-card` so no CSS changed. 15 lines; nothing else on the front moved - the stream cap stays at 20 and already says newest 20 of 320.

**Verified:** renders at 400 and 1920, zero console errors on both the synthesis and the front, every internal link resolves (clicked through headless), no horizontal overflow. Private server on 8094, torn down; :80 never touched.
